title: Void Warden - Soul Harbinger
description: Void Warden adds a single, handcrafted weapon the Soul Harbinger — a void-infused mace with a unique two-stage combat mechanic that rewards aggressive, aerial playstyle
body:
⚔️ Void Warden — Soul Harbinger


Fall upon your foe with 5 charges to unleash Void Eruption


Void Warden adds a single, handcrafted weapon to Minecraft: the Soul Harbinger — a void-infused mace with a unique two-stage combat mechanic that rewards aggressive, aerial playstyle.

🗡️ The Soul Harbinger

ValueAttack Damage+8.0 (9.0 total)

Attack Speed 0.6 swings/sec — slow and deliberate

Durability 1,024

Repair Material Netherite Ingot

Enchantable Yes

⚡ Unique Mechanics

1 — Soul Charge (passive)

Every hit on a living entity adds +1 Soul Charge (max 5), stored on the weapon itself. Charges persist between swings and are shown in the item tooltip. With each charge gained, soul flame particles burst around the target — a visual cue of building power.

2 — Void Eruption (active)

When you have 5 charges and attack while falling or airborne, the weapon detonates:

🟣 Wither II applied to the target for 3 seconds

⬆️ Target is launched upward (knocked into the air)

💀 +8 bonus void damage that bypasses armor entirely

💥 Burst of soul fire, explosion, and soul particles

🔊 Dramatic impact sounds

🔄 All charges reset to 0


🔨 Crafting Recipe

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aee9aef049becdb65943d4552a22838403d0a661.png)

2× Echo Shard — from Ancient Cities in the Deep Dark

1× Nether Star — dropped by the Wither

1× Netherite Ingot

1× Blaze Rod — from Nether Fortress blazes

The recipe unlocks in your recipe book when you pick up a Nether Star.
